title: Inspect the Table
text: Check whether $$sin\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)$$ approaches one real number as $$x$$ approaches $$0$$.\n##figure2.gif##

title: Check for a Single Approached Value
text: Do the outputs approach one number?

title: Recognize Oscillation
text: The outputs keep oscillating between $$-1$$ and $$1$$ near $$x=0$$, so lim_x->0 $$sin\left(\frac{1}{x}\right)$$ does not exist.\n##figure3.gif##
